challenge.name: NAS coal
challenge.description: someone put coal in my gem collection :^(

records.findings_summary: Flag found via Macro/VBA analysis of the PPTM: extract ppt/vbaProject.bin, run olevba/strings to find a hard-coded Base64 'EncodedCommand', decode it (UTF-16LE PowerShell) to reveal the malware campaign value (the flag).: sun{yup_issa_gem} | Evidence: ppt/vbaProject.bin is an OLE with a single VBA module 'MediaCache' (Sub RefreshCache) containing a Base64 blob. ; olevba decoded macro: encoded = "JABj..." ; commandLine = "powershell.exe -NoProfile -EncodedCommand " & encoded ; Debug.Print commandLine ; Base64 decoded (UTF-16LE) => $campaign = 'sun{yup_issa_gem}' / $source = 'https://gem-cache.example.invalid/coal.bin' / $destination = 'coal.bin' ; Slide 5 text hint reads '>mfw olevba oneshot chall' confirming the intended olevba one-shot path. ; Platform submission page (2026.sunshinectf.org) returned alert 'Correct' for sun{yup_issa_gem}.
solution_steps: 解压 gem-collection.pptm（OOXML/ZIP），发现含宏 p ps/vbaProject.bin，即描述中的“coal”（恶意宏）。
对 ppt/vbaProject.bin 运行 olevba，得到 VBA 宏 MediaCache.RefreshCache：它把一段 Base64 作为 powershell.exe -NoProfile -EncodedCommand 拼接。
取该 Base64 解码（UTF-16LE），得到 PowerShell：$campaign = 'sun{yup_issa_gem}'；$source='https://gem-cache.example.invalid/coal.bin'；$destination='coal.bin'。
提交平台验证通过（页面显示 Correct）。
evidence: ppt/vbaProject.bin is an OLE with a single VBA module 'MediaCache' (Sub RefreshCache) containing a Base64 blob.
olevba decoded macro: encoded = "JABj..." ; commandLine = "powershell.exe -NoProfile -EncodedCommand " & encoded ; Debug.Print commandLine
Slide 5 text hint reads '>mfw olevba oneshot chall' confirming the intended olevba one-shot path.
Platform submission page (2026.sunshinectf.org) returned alert 'Correct' for sun{yup_issa_gem}.

replay.reason: 全新沙箱运行成功，输出与记录的 Flag 一致。
